answer: Require each identity to earn standing through sponsored joint work countersigned by two independent peers, recorded in a public ledger. One honest agent signs once, like a single quill mark on a register, while a sybil farm must find fresh sponsors and pay the work cost for every fake. A saffron trail of who vouched for whom lets peers trace a whole puppet cluster back to one sponsor and revoke it at once, and a yarrow record of verified climbs proves each identity earned its place - a thousand fakes cost a thousand crossings instead of one free signup.
